display_name: Law 08/2022/QH15 on Insurance Business (Luật Kinh doanh bảo hiểm), all 157 articles as made and as amended by Law 139/2025/QH15, in three vintages

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

metrics.note: From the CLI's result and init events. The claude-fable-5-1 share is reported by the CLI and is not explained here.

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese appears only in `-- src:N |` comment lines generated mechanically from line N of a deposited source (tools/expand.py), and in short runs in GLOSSARY.md and NOTES.md that tools/vnsrc.py checks occur verbatim in a source.

scope: The whole Act: all 157 articles of Law 08/2022/QH15 in V1, and the effect on them of all 25 numbered clauses of Law 139/2025/QH15 in V2 and V3. Encoded: definitions (Điều 4) as predicates over witness facts; Chương II (Điều 15-61) article by article; Chương III-VII with dated arms where Law 139/2025/QH15 changed the text; every delegation to the Government or the Minister of Finance as a named REFUSE with a test; the deferred commencements of Điều 156(2) and the transitional dates of Điều 156-157 in each vintage. Inert (labelled stubs): statements of policy, lists of addressees and of State functions, duties of internal organisation judged by adequacy. Not encoded: any other law (Civil Code, Maritime Code, Law on Enterprises, Law on Investment, Bankruptcy Law and others), which are inputs or refusals. See NOTES.md sections 1-2.

V2.what: V1 with Law 139/2025/QH15 Điều 1 and Điều 2 applied except Điều 2(6) and 2(8); applied by this encoder to V1

V3.what: V2 with Điều 2(6) and 2(8) of Law 139/2025/QH15 also applied (Điều 3(2) of that Law); applied by this encoder

forks.F1: Which kind of day 'ngay' is (calendar or working); read as calendar days.
forks.F2: Rules that read no vintage date do not refuse before 1 January 2023.
forks.F3: Điều 3(1): the consequence for a later law that differs without saying what content it applies is not stated.
forks.F4: Điều 4(6): the two limbs of brokerage are alternatives.
forks.F5: Điều 8(2)(c) and Law 139 Điều 2(1): whether 'hoạt động xây dựng' is wider than 'hoạt động đầu tư xây dựng'.
forks.F6: Điều 63(3): 'từ 01 năm trở xuống' is a term of 12 months or less, and the two products of (b) are each separately allowed.
forks.F7: Điều 22(2), 35, 47(2): a refund net of reasonable costs cannot be negative.
forks.F8: Điều 26: which side may terminate on which ground.
forks.F9: Điều 28: all three conditions of the transfer are conditions of effect.
forks.F10: Điều 30(1): the last day of the one year is the anniversary of the starting day, plus the force majeure days; the leap-day start is not decided.
forks.F11: Điều 30(2)-(3): which start day wins when the claimant did not know of the event and a third person has also made a demand.
forks.F12: Điều 31(2): the interest rate is the parties' (Civil Code) and is taken as a rate per day; there is no default.
forks.F13: Điều 27(2): the premium refund 'theo thỏa thuận' is taken as the premium paid for the remaining period.
forks.F14: Điều 35: 'thời hạn trên 01 năm' is tested by the last day of the term falling after the first anniversary of the first day.
forks.F15: Điều 35: the 21 days run from the day the policyholder receives the contract, which is day 0.
forks.F16: Điều 35 applies to every contract of more than a year, not only life and health.
forks.F17: Điều 37(2): the 60 days of grace run from a date the contract or the instalment fixes; the encoding takes that date as an input.
forks.F18: Điều 39: for a minor the parent's or guardian's written consent also satisfies the person's own consent in paragraph 1.
forks.F19: Điều 40(3): 'giá trị hoàn lại ... hoặc toàn bộ số phí bảo hiểm đã đóng sau khi trừ các chi phí hợp lý' is a single figure supplied as an input.
forks.F20: Điều 46(1): the reduction cannot take the compensation below zero.
forks.F21: Điều 47(2)(a): 'tương ứng' is premium x (sum insured - market value) / sum insured.
forks.F22: Điều 47(2)(b): 'bồi thường thiệt hại tương ứng với giá thị trường ... tại thời điểm xảy ra thiệt hại' is read as capped at that market value.
forks.F23: Working days (Điều 117): Saturday and Sunday are not working days and a calendar of other non-working days is supplied.
forks.F24: Điều 98(2): the last year's contribution is limited to the room left under the maximum.
forks.F25: Điều 101 (V2): the second paragraph names no duty for a reinsurer or a mutual organisation, so none is applied.
forks.F26: Điều 65: the Law's two thresholds and the Government's 'mức tổng tài sản tối thiểu phù hợp với từng thời kỳ' both apply.
forks.F27: Điều 58(1): 'trong thời hạn bảo hiểm' qualifies the act (an occurrence rule); the claims-made reading is also encoded, separately.
forks.F28: Điều 87(3): a product line the article does not name has no premium-method requirement.
forks.F29: Điều 81: 'doanh nghiệp' (V1) and 'tổ chức' (V2) in the experience limb for board members are not distinguished.
forks.F30: Điều 127(1) (V1): 'cùng loại hình bảo hiểm' is tested by the two principals carrying on a type of insurance in common.
forks.F31: Điều 64(1): limb (a) applies to every founder, limb (b) to organisations, limb (c) to licensed insurers founding a new one; '10% trở lên' includes 10%.
forks.F32: Điều 79(1)(b): 'ít nhất 20% số thành viên Hội đồng quản trị phải là thành viên độc lập' is tested without rounding.
forks.F33: Điều 40(1)-(2): the beneficiary at fault is not paid; the other beneficiaries are; where there is a single beneficiary the exclusion applies to the claim.
forks.F34: Inclusive bounds: 'không được ... quá 30%' (99(2)(d)), 'tối thiểu 75%' (90(2)(đ)), 'trở lên' (120(1)(m)) are tested with the figure itself passing.
forks.F35: Điều 120(1)(đ): a transfer that takes a holder to 10% or above, or below 10%, is unusual information; a move inside either band is not.
forks.F36: Điều 73(1): the extension is counted in months from the licence date, 12 + n.
forks.F37: Dated arms and the day in the question: a deferred commencement (Điều 156(2)) is asked of two clocks, the text in force and the day.
forks.F38: Điều 8(5), 17(2), 87(5)-(6) and the other delegations: the Government's and the Minister's content is never supplied; a rule that needs it refuses.

findings.W1: The replaced Điều 73 drops the bar on carrying on insurance business before the date of official operation.
findings.W2: From 2028 to 2030 the V2 text has the capital adequacy ratio (Điều 95) in force but not the supervisory measures (Điều 109-114, 116), while old Điều 77-81, 83, 98 and the interim duty of Điều 156(4) run on.
findings.W3: Điều 153(1)(c) lets the Ministry ask banks about breaches of provisions not yet in force (Điều 95, 99(3)-(4), 109, 110).
findings.W4: The repeal of Điều 155 from 1 July 2026 says nothing of the lines it added to the Investment Law's Appendix IV.
findings.W5: V3 repeals Điều 143 (conditions for ancillary services) and strikes ancillary services from the bar in Điều 9(3), yet Điều 4(7), 63(1)(c), 131(2) and 140-142 still let insurers, brokers and others supply them.
findings.W6: Điều 35 sits in the section on life and health contracts, but its words give every contract of more than a year a 21-day withdrawal.
findings.W7: Điều 26 gives either side the right to terminate on four grounds without saying which side may use which.
findings.W8: Điều 58(1) reads as an occurrence rule or as a claims-made rule, with opposite answers.
findings.W9: Điều 148(2) names the general rules, life, health and property contracts of Chương II for a mutual organisation's contracts and is silent on damage and liability contracts, though Điều 15(1) lists damage contracts separately.
findings.W10: Điều 65(3) lets the Government fix the minimum total assets 'for each period' on the basis of figures the Law itself states.
findings.W11: After Điều 69 is repealed (V2) the 60 days of Điều 70(1) still run from a 'hồ sơ hợp lệ' the Law no longer describes.
findings.W12: Điều 127(1) in V1 and V2 bars different pairs of principals.
findings.W13: V2 drops 'the right to manage an enterprise under the Law on Enterprises' from the general conditions of an officer.
findings.W14: The deposit of Điều 96 is 2% of the MINIMUM charter capital at establishment, so it does not grow with the insurer.
findings.W15: Điều 98 sets aside 5% of after-tax profit until a maximum the Government fixes; the Law gives no maximum, so the contribution cannot be computed from the Law alone.
findings.W16: The Law counts 'ngày' without defining it and uses 'ngày làm việc' only in Điều 117.
findings.W17: The V2 extension of agent certificates in Điều 157(2) restores a use the V1 text had ended.
findings.W18: Two rules for the same shortfall of assets on a transfer of portfolio: a pro rata refund (Điều 27(4)) and a negotiated reduction (Điều 92(3)).
findings.W19: The phrase swaps of Law 139/2025/QH15 Điều 2(1) (Điều 8) and Điều 1(2) (Điều 63) change who is covered, not only wording.
findings.W20: Điều 40(1)(a) counts the 2 years from the first premium OR from the restoration, so a restored old contract has a fresh suicide exclusion.
findings.W21: Điều 25(1)(h) makes void a contract made because a party was deceived, except in the case of Điều 22, where a deliberate misstatement by either side gives rescission and a refund instead; the Law does not draw the line between the two.
findings.R1: Điều 116(3)(c) ranks only claims the insurer 'đã ... chấp thuận chi trả': a claim not yet accepted has no rank at all.
findings.R2: Điều 115(1)(d) refers to 'thời gian áp dụng biện pháp kiểm soát' (Điều 113), which does not exist until 2028 (V1) or 2031 (V2), though Điều 115 takes effect in 2023.
findings.R3: Điều 135 and 138(8) cite Điều 71 and 117 whole; Điều 71(3) and 117(3) are repealed from V2, so a broker has no registry-notification duty and no 7-working-day notice duty in V2.
findings.R4: Điều 3(3) (new in V2) states the right to contribute capital in terms that overlap Điều 64(1)(a) and 133(1)(a) (repealed the same day), but speaks of 'góp vốn thành lập, quản lý, kiểm soát' rather than of licensing conditions.
findings.R5: Law 139/2025/QH15 was passed on 10 December 2025 and published in Công báo số 39 of 22 January 2026 but takes effect on 1 January 2026, and its Điều 1(15) extends a period that V1 ended on 31 December 2025.
findings.R6: Điều 157(3) keeps ancillary certificates usable though Điều 143(4), the basis for issuing them, is repealed from V3.
findings.R7: Early intervention and control are triggered by a ratio 'ở mức phải áp dụng' which the Law does not state (the Minister decides, Điều 109(3)), and the Ministry's choice of measures in Điều 112(6) and 113(8) is 'tùy theo tính chất, mức độ, rủi ro' with no criteria.
findings.R8: Điều 65(1)(d) asks 2 billion US dollars of a foreign member and Điều 65(2) 2,000 billion VND of a Vietnamese one; at any rate near the one widely reported these differ by a large factor (outside knowledge, unverified; no exchange rate is in the sources).
findings.R9: Điều 3(1) says a later law that wants to differ 'phải xác định cụ thể' what it applies, but gives no consequence for failing.
findings.R10: Điều 8(2)(c): the Law does not define 'hoạt động đầu tư xây dựng' or 'hoạt động xây dựng', so whether the V2 change widens or narrows compulsory construction insurance cannot be told from the sources.
